title: DecisionModelCreateCoreOptions
description: The question schema passed to DecisionModel.availability() and DecisionModel.create(), with the limits of the reference build (Chrome 160). RFC-0001; docs/spec/decisions-api-surface.md §3–4. JSON-serializable members only: signal and monitor are not JSON.
$comment: Not expressible in JSON Schema and checked by the library with Chrome's errors: unique question ids, unique option labels within a question, valid BCP 47 language tags, and 'questions' being required by create() (availability() accepts it absent). Unknown members are allowed, as a WebIDL dictionary ignores them; the version-specific members 'context' (Chrome 157) and 'devTrialBackend' (Chrome 160, Dev Trial) are therefore not described here.

preference.description: PerformancePreference; 'auto' when absent. The library uses it to pick the model tier (RFC-0001 §4).

type.description: LanguageModelMessageType. Only 'text' is supported: any other gives 'unavailable' (availability) or NotSupportedError (create).

languages.description: BCP 47 tags; an invalid tag is a RangeError, an uncovered language gives 'unavailable'.
